charges.name: Light dues
charges.applies_when: Light dues are payable in accordance with the vessel's tonnage definition.

charges.name: LIGHT DUES
charges.applies_when: Payable by self-propelled vessels, all other vessels, and coasters entering or operating within South African waters and ports under specific conditions and timeframes.

charges.name: SAMSA Levy
charges.applies_when: Payable as prescribed in the SAMSA Levy Determination Regulations in force, excluding foreign naval or war vessels.

charges.name: VTS charges
charges.applies_when: Payable by vessels based on their gross tonnage for safe navigation, pollution, and conservancy.

charges.name: VTS CHARGES
charges.applies_when: Payable per GT per port call by vessels calling all ports under the control of the Authority and vessels performing port related services within port limits and approaches to port limits.

charges.name: Pilotage services
charges.applies_when: Payable for normal entering or leaving the port, unauthorized vessel movements, specific surcharges outside working hours or due to delays/cancellations, and for PLO duties on tanker vessels at Saldanha.

charges.name: Fees for surveying/examination of small vessels and life saving appliances
charges.applies_when: Payable per service when a survey or examination of small vessels or life saving appliances is conducted.

charges.name: PILOTAGE EXEMPTION CERTIFICATE
charges.applies_when: Payable for vessels applying for a pilotage exemption certificate based on their length overall, with exemptions for SAPS and SANDF vessels.

charges.name: Tugs/Vessel Assistance and/or Attendance
charges.applies_when: Payable for tugs/vessels assisting and/or attending vessels within the confines of the port.

charges.name: Tanker fire watch, fire fighting, standby services, floating cranes, tug/vessel services, launch services
charges.applies_when: When vessels require tanker fire watch, fire fighting, standby services, floating crane hire, tug services, or launch services.

charges.name: Berthing Services
charges.applies_when: Payable per service for vessels entering or leaving a port, shifting berth, undergoing engine trials, remooring and crewing, or when berthing gangs stand by or are detained.

charges.name: Running of vessels' lines
charges.applies_when: Payable per service when a launch or mooring boat is used to run vessels' lines from the ship to the bollard, or when standing by, or for delayed arrivals and departures, cancellations of standby duty, and remooring without tug/pilots.

charges.name: Hire of Marine Equipment/Marine Services
charges.applies_when: Marine equipment or marine services are hired or utilized.

charges.name: Port Dues
charges.applies_when: Payable by vessels entering the port, taking in bunkers at the designated anchorage, or at offshore moorings or similar facilities.

charges.name: Berth dues
charges.applies_when: Payable by any vessel occupying a repair quay or any other berth and not handling cargo, or when occupying berths under specific conditions such as exceeding allowed time limits while shipping ore.

charges.name: Port Dues for Small Vessels, Hulks and Pleasure Vessels
charges.applies_when: Payable when small vessels, hulks, pleasure vessels, or visiting vessels are allowed access, moor, or operate within the port.

charges.name: Fire and Emergency Services Fees
charges.applies_when: Payable when fire and emergency services, equipment, or staff are utilized.

charges.name: Use of fire extinguishers
charges.applies_when: It becomes payable when fire extinguishers are used and need to be recharged.

charges.name: Tanker Fire Watch - Tug
charges.applies_when: Payable when a tanker fire watch service is provided by a tug for a duration of 12-36 or 12-48 hours.

charges.name: Fire Protection and Hotwork Inspection Services
charges.applies_when: Payable when fire protection duties or hotwork fire safety inspection services are provided.

charges.name: Fire Awareness Training
charges.applies_when: Payable when requesting fire awareness training courses, drills, simulations, or risk assessments.

charges.name: Fire Equipment Maintenance
charges.applies_when: It becomes payable when fire equipment maintenance and servicing services are requested or performed.

charges.name: Fire Equipment Hire
charges.applies_when: Payable when training facilities, fire pumps, ejector pumps, fire hoses, branch pipes and nozzles, fire extinguishers, or fire tenders and drivers are hired.

charges.name: Crew Transportation
charges.applies_when: It becomes payable per day when a vehicle is provided by the Authority's security to crew members for vessels at Island View berths 1-8 to transport them from the vessel to the Check Point.

charges.name: Fees for the supply of fresh water
charges.applies_when: Fresh water is supplied upon application.

charges.name: Removal of refuse
charges.applies_when: Fees for the removal of refuse from the port are compulsory where applicable and available on application.

charges.name: Combating of oil pollution
charges.applies_when: Fees are raised for the combating of oil pollution in the port area.

charges.name: Passenger baggage handling fee
charges.applies_when: The Authority is involved in the handling of passenger baggage, other than manifested baggage, for all passengers on embarkation or on disembarkation.

charges.name: PASSENGERS' LEVY
charges.applies_when: Payable for all passengers on embarkation, disembarkation, or as a visiting passenger in transit per call.

charges.name: Amending Fees
charges.applies_when: Amending fees are payable for all changes to marine order post invoicing which arise from customer initiated requests.

charges.name: Split Account Fees
charges.applies_when: The split account fee is levied per party prior to vessel sailing, and twice per party after vessel sailing or when a marine invoice is credited and re-debited after vessel sailing at the client's request.

charges.name: Licence fees
charges.applies_when: Licence fees are payable in equal installments, on an annual basis, over the period of the licence.

charges.name: Vessel agent registration fee
charges.applies_when: It becomes payable per port for the duration of vessel agent registration.

charges.name: Motor vehicle access permit fee per financial year
charges.applies_when: A motor vehicle access permit is obtained for a financial year.

charges.name: Small vessel permit fee / Pleasure vessel permit fee
charges.applies_when: It becomes payable when obtaining a port rule permit for small vessels and pleasure vessels, though the fee is currently free.

charges.name: Permit replacement fee
charges.applies_when: Payable when a permit is replaced.

charges.name: Hull Cleaning Permit Fee
charges.applies_when: It becomes payable per annum for a hull cleaning permit.

charges.name: Booking deposits for drydock, floating dock or syncrolift
charges.applies_when: A firm booking has been made for the use of a drydock, floating dock or syncrolift.

charges.name: drydock or floating dock booking deposit
charges.applies_when: A firm booking is made for the use of a drydock or floating dock.

charges.name: Slipways deposit
charges.applies_when: A firm booking has been made for the use of slipway.

charges.name: penalty on dry-dock, floating dock and syncrolift dues
charges.applies_when: Vessels exceed their allocated scheduled booking dates for the dry-dock, floating dock and syncrolift occupancy period.

charges.name: preparation fees
charges.applies_when: The booking of a drydock is cancelled after the preparatory work has begun.

charges.name: Drydock and floating dock preparation fee
charges.applies_when: Payable per vessel for the preparation of a drydock.

charges.name: Docking and undocking of vessels
charges.applies_when: Fees are payable per service for the docking and undocking of vessels, or when a request for services outside ordinary working hours is cancelled after staff have been brought on duty.

charges.name: Drydock
charges.applies_when: Fees are payable per service for the docking and undocking of vessels at the Port of Durban, and apply also when a requested service outside ordinary working hours is cancelled after staff have been brought on duty.

charges.name: Drydock, floating dock and syncrolift dues
charges.applies_when: Payable for the use of a repair facility by vessels.

charges.name: Drydock, floating dock and syncrolift dues
charges.applies_when: Fees are payable for the use of a repair facility at the Port of Durban based on the gross tonnage of the vessel.

charges.name: Syncrolift Dues
charges.applies_when: It becomes payable when a vessel uses the Syncrolift at the Port of Cape Town.

charges.name: Minimum fees
charges.applies_when: Minimum fees become payable for the use of drydocks, floating docks, and syncrolifts during the first 24 hour period or part thereof and each subsequent 12 hour period or part thereof.

charges.name: Slipway preparation costs and Docking and Undocking of vessels at a slipway
charges.applies_when: Payable when a slipway booking is cancelled after preparatory work has begun, or per service for the docking and undocking of vessels.

charges.name: Wharf cranes outside ordinary working hours
charges.applies_when: One wharf crane is provided outside ordinary working hours.

charges.name: Wharf cranes
charges.applies_when: An additional wharf crane is provided outside ordinary working hours.

charges.name: Cargo dues
charges.applies_when: Cargo dues are levied on all commodities, articles, things or containers (full or empty) handled as imports, exports, transhipments, and coastwise at all ports.

charges.name: Breakbulk Tariff
charges.applies_when: It becomes payable when breakbulk commodities are imported or exported.

charges.name: Dry Bulk Tariffs
charges.applies_when: It becomes payable when dry bulk commodities are imported or exported.

charges.name: Liquid Bulk
charges.applies_when: It becomes payable when liquid bulk commodities are imported or exported.

charges.name: container fees
charges.applies_when: The container is imported or exported through the port.

charges.name: Coastwise Cargo
charges.applies_when: It becomes payable for coastwise cargo per leg inwards or outwards, including breakbulk, bulk, and containerised cargo.

charges.name: Transhipped Cargo Fees
charges.applies_when: Cargo or empty containers are transshipped, landed in error, over carried, supplied as bunker fuel oil direct from tankers, or handled due to container malfunction.

charges.name: Late order and related fees
charges.applies_when: Late order fee is applicable for cancellations and late submission of cargo documentation.

charges.name: late cargo dues order fees and penalties
charges.applies_when: Late cargo dues order fees and penalties apply when a cargo dues order is incorrect, incomplete, or submitted in a pending status due to credit issues.

charges.name: Cargo dues
charges.applies_when: Cargo dues are payable by the importer or exporter of cargo, or alternatively billed to the container operator or vessel agent under specific conditions.

charges.name: Late order fees for late submission of Cargo Dues Orders
charges.applies_when: Cargo Dues Orders are submitted to the Authority after the stipulated timeframes.

charges.name: Late order fee
charges.applies_when: It becomes payable when cargo dues orders are submitted late or when a non-submission is discovered by the Authority.

charges.name: Late order fee for late and incomplete or non-submission of manifests/outturns
charges.applies_when: It becomes payable when manifests or outturn reports are submitted late, incomplete, or not at all.

charges.name: amending fee
charges.applies_when: An amending fee is charged per order for amendments made after seven (7) days.
